svg.title: MTL-PINN: physics-aware multitask learning for parametric PDEs
svg.desc: A shared backbone receives the coordinates x and t and feeds four linear heads, one per training parameter. A voter network scores each head from the query parameter mu and the head parameter, and a softmax turns the scores into weights that combine the heads into the solution u(x, t; mu), trained with a physics-informed loss. A solution from a classical solver can be added as an extra head. Two training strategies are shown (two-phase and one-phase), together with the training range in mu, where the model interpolates, and the regions outside it, where it extrapolates. Benchmarks: Poisson, Heat, Burgers, Fisher-KPP and Lamb-Chaplygin.
